title: WhatsApp working on customizable emoji reaction sets on iOS - 9to5Mac
summary: New references in the latest WhatsApp beta for iOS suggest users may soon be able to replace the app’s standard set of emoji reactions with their own selection. Users will also be able to restore the default reaction tray at any time.
